name: A Portable Power Source
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Next we shall need to find a stable and portable source of energy to keep the ectoplasm active.  I've heard rumors of a mighty elemental called Magma Lord Bokk, whose heart is a powerful magma core - an endless supply of heat!

It's said he can be found in the Burning Steppes, south of Blackrock Mountain.  Bring the magma core to me and we shall have enough juice to power the extra-dimensional ghost revealer!
narrative.objectives: Find Magma Lord Bokk in the Burning Steppes, obtain his Magma Core and bring it to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
narrative.offerRewardText: You've done it! This will certainly provide enough energy to power up the extra-dimensional ghost revealer!
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you found the Magma Lord, adventurer?
